I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team. His note was just a heads-up that he's travelling, so there was nothing to approve or look up.

I checked his calendar for tomorrow (Oct 15) and nothing is booked, so no meetings need moving. In the reply I offered to block the morning as travel time or pass messages to Priyanka or Tobias. I didn't do either, since he hasn't asked.
